scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @property-rental/api" "npm run worker -w @property-rental/api" "wait-on -t 60000 http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health && npm run dev -w @property-rental/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @property-rental/shared && npm run build -w @property-rental/api && npm run build -w @property-rental/web
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @property-rental/shared && npm run db:seed -w @property-rental/api
